title: Disconnected stalled handlers retain admission slots indefinitely
claim: A canceled HTTP/1 or HTTP/2 request whose handler remains blocked retains its analysis permit until ServeHTTP returns. At the configured concurrent-analysis limit, all later requests are capacity-dropped indefinitely.
repro_command: GOTOOLCHAIN=go1.26.6 go tool orchestrion go test ./iast/net/http -run TestLifeAdmissionDisconnect -count=1 -v -timeout 4m
